title: Create the Gapminder dataset
text:
# Import necessary libraries
import pandas as pd
from gapminder import gapminder

# Rename 'lifeExp' to 'life_expectancy' and 'gdpPercap' to 'gdp_per_capita'
gapminder = gapminder.rename(columns={'lifeExp': 'life_expectancy',
                                      'pop': 'population_millions', 
                                      'gdpPercap': 'gdp_per_capita'})

# Convert population to millions
gapminder['population_millions'] = gapminder['population_millions'] / 1_000_000

# Create a new pandas DataFrame from the modified gapminder data
gapminder_df = pd.DataFrame(gapminder)

# Save the DataFrame as a CSV file
gapminder_df.to_csv('gapminder.csv', index=False)

# Print the first 3 rows of the DataFrame
print(gapminder_df.head(3))

title: Country Analysis
text:
This page analyzes how life expectancy, GDP per capita, and population have changed over time for a specific country in the Gapminder dataset.

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

# Choose a country
country_name = "United States"

# Filter data for that country
country_df = df[df["country"] == country_name].sort_values("year")

# Create line plot
fig = px.line(
    country_df,
    x="year",
    y=["life_expectancy", "gdp_per_capita", "population_millions"],
    markers=True,
    labels={
        "year": "Year",
        "value": "Value",
        "variable": "Metric"
    },
    title=f"Changes Over Time: {country_name}"
)

fig.show()

title: Life Expectancy and Population
text:
This page explores the relationship between life expectancy and population across countries over time using the Gapminder dataset.

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

fig = px.scatter(
    df,
    x="population_millions",
    y="life_expectancy",
    animation_frame="year",
    animation_group="country",
    color="continent",
    hover_name="country",
    log_x=True,
    labels={
        "population_millions": "Population (millions, log scale)",
        "life_expectancy": "Life Expectancy (years)"
    },
    title="Life Expectancy vs Population Over Time"
)

fig.show()
